# Contributing to <repository-name>

## Development setup

```bash
git clone <repository-url>
cd <repository-name>
bun install
```

## Commit messages

We use [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) for commit messages to the main branch. Make sure your PR title is in the correct format.

## Pull requests

Follow the repository-local [open-pull-request skill](../.agents/skills/open-pull-request/SKILL.md)
when drafting or opening a pull request.
